projects.title: Ray’s Mobile Repair
projects.tagline: A local business. A clear online home.
projects.summary: A website built around a local business and the customers who count on it. Clear services, direct contact, and a place for the business to grow.

cover.alt: Ray’s Mobile Repair website, with its green and gold branding, service truck, and clear Call Now and Request Service buttons.
cover.caption: The Ray’s Mobile Repair homepage, with direct paths to call or request service.

projects.need: Give a local mobile repair business a clear online home. Explain the services, introduce the business, and help customers reach Ray when a truck or piece of equipment needs attention.
projects.build: A custom, mobile-friendly website shaped around Ray’s branding, service offering, and story. Dedicated pages cover repair services, fleet support, hiring, and customer contact.
projects.experience: Visitors can call for urgent repair, send a service request, explore fleet support, or apply for a job. Each path supports a real part of the business’s day.
